operations.original: It proves the resolvent compression inequality for the negative logarithm and develops partial-trace and channel data processing through finite Stinespring dilation, using [[thm-it-quantum-relative-entropy-joint-convexity|joint convexity]] from Quantum Information Measures.
operations.proposed: It uses the resolvent compression inequality, the Jensen inequality for the negative logarithm, and partial-trace and channel data processing through finite Stinespring dilation, proved together with [[thm-it-quantum-relative-entropy-joint-convexity|joint convexity]] on [[quantum-information-measures|Quantum Information Measures]].
